_what: Every narration sentence AND every on-screen string maps to the essay. Titles and credits are tagged as such and approved. Attributions are declared and signed off separately.
thesis: Value is ascribed, not intrinsic. CENTS runs one of the most ordinary objects on Earth through five regimes of value ascription and leaves it in a sixth that never closes, so the work's value, meaning and even its nature keep being redefined by its participants.

claims.say: Rutherford Chang began CENTS with a simple value discrepancy.
claims.span: Rutherford Chang began this project with a simple value discrepancy

claims.say: What was one cent to the US Treasury was about two and a half cents as copper at the time he made the piece.
claims.span: the difference between the value of ¢1 ascribed to copper pennies by the US Treasury versus the metal value of apx. ¢2.5
claims.note: SPOKEN REVISION. 'at the time he made the piece' is the speaker's qualifier and is not in the essay. It NARROWS the essay's claim rather than extending it - the copper price moves, so the 2.5x ratio is tied to when the work was made. Recorded as a paraphrase for that reason, but the qualifier is the speaker's, not the source's.

claims.say: Nothing had been sold for a single cent since before Chang was born, yet the object remained, buoyed into physicality by the force of its context.
claims.span: there was no longer anything sold for a single cent, and by 2006, shortly after he graduated from university, it had become more expensive to produce one cent than one cent. Yet the object remained, buoyed into physicality by the force of its context
claims.note: two written lines spoken as one sentence; the span is contiguous in the essay and covers both clauses.

claims.say: The readymade he chose is also perhaps the most reproduced physical artwork on Earth.
claims.span: The image of Lincoln on the face of the penny, created by Victor David Brenner, is the most reproduced artwork on planet Earth
claims.note: SPOKEN REVISION: 'also perhaps' hedges the superlative. The essay asserts it outright for the image; the speaker hedges it for the object. A hedge can only reduce the claim, so this is safer than the written line it replaces.

claims.say: More than five hundred billion Lincoln cents were produced, each with the portrait of Lincoln that Victor David Brenner made in 1909.
claims.note: SPOKEN ADDITION: the date 1909 is not in the essay. It is correct - the Lincoln cent was first struck in 1909, for the centenary of Lincoln's birth, from Victor David Brenner's portrait - and it was said by the essay's author, so it is approved rather than removed. The coin count and the attribution to Brenner are the essay's: 'its presence on the 500+ billion Lincoln cents that have been struck'.

claims.say: It is absurd that a nation's currency should dissolve into worthlessness.
claims.span: It is absurd that a nation’s currency should dissolve into worthlessness

claims.say: It is absurd that a cent should be valued at hundreds or thousands of dollars.
claims.span: It is absurd that a cent should be valued at hundreds/thousands of dollars
claims.note: the essay's slash is read as 'or'

claims.say: Chang brings a kind of black hole humor to his work, laughing at this absurdity with a laughter that resonates with an emptiness.
claims.span: he brings what I call a “black hole humor” to the process — the kind of laughter that resonates within emptiness
claims.note: ATTRIBUTION: 'black hole humor' is the ESSAYIST'S coinage ('what I call'). The humor is credited to Chang, which the essay asserts; the naming is not. 'laughing at this absurdity' is the speaker's link to 'the absurdity of value ascription', which the essay names. Said 'resonates with an emptiness', not the essay's 'within emptiness'.

claims.say: In the system Chang created, every cent is passed through five transformations of value.
claims.span: Each of the objects also goes through 5 transformations of value
claims.note: SPOKEN REVISION: 'In the system Chang created' replaces the written 'Every Cent passes through'.

claims.say: One, in circulation, its value defined by the Treasury.
claims.span: being in circulation (value defined by US treasury)

claims.say: Two, removed from circulation, that value assignment subverted.
claims.span: being removed from circulation (centralized value assignment subverted)

claims.say: Three, archivally photographed, valued for what the image holds.
claims.span: being archivally photographed (value defined by visual/conceptual/historical quality)

claims.say: Four, destroyed, melted into a block of copper, its value made undefinable.
claims.note: SPOKEN ADDITION of the mechanism, which is the essay's: 'melting them down into a solid copper block'.

claims.say: Five, inscribed on Bitcoin, its value continually redefined by decentralized consensus as the objects are traded every day on the open market.
claims.span: being inscribed on Bitcoin (value continually redefined by decentralized consensus)
claims.note: SPOKEN ADDITION of 'as the objects are traded every day on the open market', which is the essay's 'placing them into a system of permissionless exchange and indeterminate, continual revaluation' said concretely. 'Every day' is the speaker's.

claims.say: CENTS is a becoming, a gesture that unfolds continually through the actions of its participants through time.
claims.span: CENTS is a becoming, a gesture that unfolds continually through the actions of its participants in time
claims.note: spoken as 'through time' where the essay has 'in time', so paraphrase rather than quotation.

distinctions_kept.distinction: FIVE NATURES (what a Cent simultaneously is) vs FIVE TRANSFORMATIONS OF VALUE (what it passes through) - two different lists of five
distinctions_kept.where: Only the TRANSFORMATIONS are narrated. The NATURES appear as on-screen text and are never on screen during the transformations chain - one list per channel, and never both at the same moment.
distinctions_kept.note: The previous film's 'five conditions' matched the TRANSFORMATIONS only. Separating the two lists by channel (voice vs frame) is the strongest separation so far, but it creates a NEW way to merge them: showing the five natures while the voice is reading the five transformations would read as one annotated list of five. The constraint is on the art direction, not on the script, so no script gate can catch it - review_shots.py is where it has to be seen.

distinctions_kept.note: Putting 'black hole humor' on screen beside Chang's name would credit the essay's phrase to the artist - the same class as the quotation once credited to Chang in the previous production.

distinctions_kept.distinction: a PROPERTY of the readymade (the Lincoln portrait's ubiquity) vs the artist's MOTIVE for choosing it
distinctions_kept.where: the film gives the origin first - 'Chang began with a simple value discrepancy' - and only then describes the object. Brenner never appears before the discrepancy.
distinctions_kept.note: Caught by the user in revision 3, where the film OPENED on Brenner and so implied Chang chose the penny because the portrait is the most reproduced artwork on Earth. The essay claims no such thing. This is the quietest kind of infidelity: every sentence was individually true to a span, and the ORDER invented an intention.

distinctions_kept.distinction: the IMAGE of Lincoln (what the essay calls the most reproduced artwork) vs the PHYSICAL PENNY that carries it
distinctions_kept.where: 'the most reproduced physical artwork' - 'physical' is what locates the superlative in the object; the next line gives the coin count as the evidence
distinctions_kept.note: The glossary already holds satoshi / inscription / image / penny apart as four things. This is the same distinction one step earlier in the work: the artwork and the object it is struck on. Collapsing them would be invisible, because the essay's own argument runs through the coin count.

distinctions_kept.distinction: an ANALOGY to canon vs a claim that CENTS has entered one
distinctions_kept.where: 'Like words that accrue significance on entering the scarce set of meanings we call canon' - the comparison is to the MECHANISM by which a scarce set confers significance, not a claim about this work's standing
distinctions_kept.note: The essay compares collectors reading the set to words accruing significance in a canon. Said slightly differently - 'CENTS enters the canon' - it becomes a claim about the work's art-historical status that the essay never makes and that the film has no standing to make. On screen, 'canon' must not appear beside the work's title or any date.

script_target: SUPERSEDED BY THE RECORDING. The written script was 200 words / ~90s. What was recorded on 2026-10-06 is 239 words and, after take selection, 124.8s of voice (~128.8s with the 4s credit tail). The lines were expanded in performance; the brief needs restating or lines need cutting.
_thesis_note: Film 1 of several on CENTS, framed on VALUE. The essay's other half - conceptual art, the loss of objecthood in digital flows, and blockchain as this era's objecthood - is a second film's thesis, not a compressed sub-section of this one. Earlier revisions of this script carried both and served neither.
